prompt:
Add the CUDA binary cache as a substituter so classic-laddie stops rebuilding CUDA packages from source. Normal cosmo PR flow. KEEP COMMENTS EXTREMELY COMPRESSED — standing maintainer preference.

*** EXECUTION RULE: DO NOT run anything in the background, do not use Monitor or background tasks, do not park or schedule a wakeup. Run verification in the FOREGROUND, wait for it, then COMMIT AND OPEN THE PR BEFORE YOU FINISH. A previous agent lost its work by backgrounding nix evaluations and exiting. ***

WHY (verified, do not re-investigate): cosmo currently configures NO substituters or trusted-public-keys anywhere. classic-laddie builds llama-cpp with cudaSupport=true, which is an override of an unfree package, so cache.nixos.org does not have it and it compiles from source — roughly 20 minutes of CUDA compilation, observed 2026-07-25. The CUDA community cache DOES have that exact store path. Verified just now by narinfo probe of /nix/store/p57dc4wgfy99zl837snsl30s8rb13df4-llama-cpp-10063:
  https://cache.nixos-cuda.org      -> HTTP 200  (has it)
  https://cuda-maintainers.cachix.org -> HTTP 404  (legacy host, does NOT have it)
  https://cache.nixos.org           -> HTTP 404  (expected)
Use cache.nixos-cuda.org. Do NOT use the old cuda-maintainers.cachix.org address — it still answers but lacks the paths.

THE CHANGE — in hosts/classic-laddie/default.nix (CUDA is specific to this host; do NOT put it in modules/common/system.nix and do not make it fleet-wide), add near the GPU/llama config:
    nix.settings = {
      substituters = [ "https://cache.nixos-cuda.org" ];
      trusted-public-keys = [ "cache.nixos-cuda.org:74DUi4Ye579gUqzH4ziL9IyiJBlDpMRn9MBN8oNan9M=" ];
    };
with a terse comment: CUDA overrides are unfree so the public cache lacks them; this serves prebuilt CUDA paths. Nothing else changes.

CRITICAL VERIFICATION — these are LIST options whose defaults already contain the official cache, and NixOS list options merge by concatenation. Confirm you have APPENDED and not REPLACED, or classic-laddie loses cache.nixos.org and rebuilds the world. Run in the foreground and paste the output:
    nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.nix.settings.substituters
    nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.nix.settings.trusted-public-keys
The first MUST still contain a cache.nixos.org entry alongside the new one; the second MUST still contain the official cache.nixos.org-1: key alongside the new one. If either shows only your new value, you have clobbered the default — fix it (mkAfter or plain list merge as appropriate) before committing.
Then also run, foreground:
    nix flake check
    nix build .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.system.build.toplevel --dry-run
Both must pass. Do not attempt a real build and do not try to fetch anything from the cache.

PR body: state the measured evidence above (the three narinfo probes), that this is classic-laddie-only because it is the sole CUDA host, and paste the two nix eval outputs proving the defaults were preserved.
Title: 'feat(classic-laddie): add CUDA binary cache substituter'.
